items.title: Pfizer repels Covid-19 sales tumble to raise 2026 guidance
items.summary: Fuelled by blockbusters such as Eliquis, Pfizer is cementing its post-Covid revenue legacy.

items.title: Supernus and Indivior merge to create scaled, CNS-focused entity
items.summary: Through this merger, Supernus and Indivior will combine their commercial medicinal portfolios, which span CNS and opioid use disorders (OUDs).

items.title: FDA grants breakthrough therapy designation to Lilly’s olomorasib
items.summary: The US FDA has granted breakthrough therapy designation to Lilly olomorasib as a potential treatment for adults with advanced pancreatic cancer who have already received at least one prior systemic therapy.

items.title: Curium to acquire Lantheus in all-cash deal worth up to $8bn
items.summary: CapVest Partners-backed Curium has agreed to acquire rival US-based radiopharmaceutical company Lantheus in an all-cash deal worth up to nearly $8bn.

items.title: Amgen contends with data breach, exposing patient information
items.summary: Amgen is investigating the extent of this breach, which has exposed private patient and proprietary information.
